# tebib_storage_key (Resource)

An S3 access key for the project's buckets. Its holder's IAM permissions decide what it can do. The secret is only known when the key is created: it is stored in the Terraform state (marked sensitive), so keep the state encrypted. An imported key has no secret.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "tebib_iam_service_account" "app" {
  name = "app"
}

resource "tebib_storage_key" "app" {
  name               = "app"
  service_account_id = tebib_iam_service_account.app.id
}

data "tebib_storage" "this" {}

# For an S3 client (rclone, the AWS SDKs...): path-style URLs.
output "s3" {
  value = {
    endpoint          = data.tebib_storage.this.endpoint
    region            = data.tebib_storage.this.region
    access_key_id     = tebib_storage_key.app.access_key_id
    secret_access_key = tebib_storage_key.app.secret_access_key
  }
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name, unique among the project's storage keys. Changing it replaces the resource.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description, at most 255 characters. Default: empty.
- `project_id` (String) Project ID (`p-...`). Default: the provider's `project`. Changing it replaces the resource.
- `service_account_id` (String) Give the key to this service account (`sa-...`). Default: the caller (the user or service account whose credentials the provider uses). Changing it replaces the key.
- `status` (String) `active` (default) or `inactive`: S3 refuses an inactive key.
- `tags` (Map of String) Tags (key-value pairs). IAM policies can match them. Default: none.
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `access_key_id` (String) The S3 access key ID.
- `created_at` (String) When it was created (RFC 3339).
- `effective_status` (String) What S3 sees now: `pending`, `active`, `inactive`, `holder-inactive` or `lost`.
- `endpoint` (String) S3 endpoint URL.
- `holder` (String) TRN of the user or service account holding the key.
- `id` (String) Storage key ID (`s3key-...`).
- `region` (String) The region name S3 clients sign requests with.
- `secret_access_key` (String, Sensitive) The S3 secret. Only set by the create; null after an import.
- `state` (String) Lifecycle state: `active` once ready (or `error`).
- `status_message` (String) What the platform last said about the resource.
- `trn` (String) TebibHost resource name (TRN), for IAM policies.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <storage_key_id>, optionally with <project_id>/ in front. An imported key has no secret.
terraform import tebib_storage_key.app s3key-abc123
```
